items.title: 1 Wing slab
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090 and 2_closeups front limb: blade tapered to a diagonal, dark top band, purple bays below, three spars radiating from the wrist; but az000 and 5_reference model az000 still show the two blades standing off the flank with daylight between wing and body, and the tip does not reach the tail base.

items.title: 2 Legs too short (Stage 1)
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090/hero: belly raised clear of the feet and a visible hock bend, but belly sits at about 28-30% of height vs the reference ~35%; still a lowish stance in 5_reference side pair. 4_posed move_f009/f017 feet plant, no knee pop.

items.title: 3 Eyes on top of skull
items.evidence: 2_closeups head colour: amber eye on the side of the head at the bill top line under a brow ledge; 1_beauty hero and az090 show it from the side/3-4 front, not from the top.

items.title: 4 Hackles bag of rocks
items.evidence: 2_closeups head colour: a few lighter ruff wedges under the jaw, nape clear, neck visible; techqa hackles clip 2 tris (<10), flip 0; 3_tech no pink/purple on the throat beyond small marks.

items.title: 5 Bill short fat wedge
items.evidence: 2_closeups head colour/wire and 1_beauty az090: long bill with downturned tip and a small pale tip covering only the front ~30%.
